name: MTTSL
recent: MTTSL 近期有多名董事与主要股东行使雇员认股计划（ESOS）期权，涉及 Ooi Lean Hin、Dato' Seri Ong Kean Lee、Ong Yee Sian、Chan Huan Hin 及 CFO Khoo Theng Fei 等人；同时公司因 ESOS 行使发行 3,155,100 股新股，于 2026 年 11 月 16 日上市。Aberdeen 系股东在 11 月初连续申报持股变动。
notable: 多名董事及首席财务官行使 ESOS 期权，涉及合计约 228 万股普通股。
公司因 ESOS 行使发行 3,155,100 股新股，发行价每股 RM1.03，新股于 2026 年 11 月 16 日上市。
Aberdeen Group PLC、abrdn Holdings Limited 及 abrdn Malaysia Sdn. Bhd. 于 11 月 4 日至 10 日期间多次申报持股变动。
risks: 董事及高级管理层在闭门期行使 ESOS 期权，导致公司发行新股，现有股东持股可能被轻微摊薄。
主要股东 Aberdeen 系机构在 11 月初多次申报持股变动，需留意其后续持股变化。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度，公司营收为 RM360.36 million，净利润为 RM94.51 million，净利率 26.2%；营收环比增长 20.8%，净利润环比增长 44.5%，上一季度净利率为 21.9%。

recent_en: MTTSL recently saw several directors and a substantial shareholder exercise ESOS options, including Ooi Lean Hin, Dato' Seri Ong Kean Lee, Ong Yee Sian, Chan Huan Hin and CFO Khoo Theng Fei; the company also issued 3,155,100 new shares under its ESOS, listed on 16 Nov 2026. Aberdeen-related shareholders filed consecutive changes in their holdings in early November.
notable_en: Several directors and the CFO exercised ESOS options involving a total of about 2.28 million ordinary shares.
The company issued 3,155,100 new shares under ESOS at RM1.03 per share, with the new shares listed on 16 Nov 2026.
Aberdeen Group PLC, abrdn Holdings Limited and abrdn Malaysia Sdn. Bhd. filed multiple changes in their holdings between 4 and 10 November.
risks_en: Directors and senior management exercised ESOS options during the closed period, resulting in new share issuance that may slightly dilute existing shareholders.
Substantial shareholder Aberdeen-related entities filed multiple changes in holdings in early November; their subsequent holdings changes should be monitored.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM360.36 million and net income was RM94.51 million, with a net margin of 26.2%; revenue grew 20.8% QoQ and net income grew 44.5% QoQ, versus a net margin of 21.9% in the prior quarter.
